Busy and quiet times

  • Quietest: mid-morning and mid-afternoon, Tuesday to Thursday.
  • Busiest: Mondays, lunchtime, Saturdays, and January through summer as travel season peaks.
  • Rule of thumb: passport windows close intake before posted closing when the day's capacity fills — earlier in your visit beats later.

Applying at COMMERCE CITY: quick checklist

  1. Form DS-11 filled out but unsigned — you sign in front of the acceptance agent.
  2. Citizenship evidence (birth certificate or old passport) + a photocopy on plain paper.
  3. Photo ID (driver's license) + photocopy.
  4. One 2x2 photo.
  5. Two payments: application fee by check or money order to "U.S. Department of State", and the $35 execution fee to the facility. Full fee table.
Already had a passport? Most adult renewals skip the acceptance facility entirely — you can renew by mail or online for $130 with no execution fee. Facilities are for first-time applicants, children under 16, and replacements after loss.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need an appointment at COMMERCE CITY?

call 303-289-3600 or go to www.c3gov.com/qless for appointments. Notary Services provided.

Can I get passport photos here?

This facility does not take photos on site, but photo services are available nearby (pharmacies and shipping stores). Bring a compliant 2x2 photo with you.

What should I bring?

Completed Form DS-11 (do not sign it beforehand), proof of U.S. citizenship plus a photocopy, valid photo ID plus a photocopy, one passport photo, and payment: the application fee by check or money order to "U.S. Department of State" and the $35 execution fee paid separately to the facility.

How much does it cost?

For a first-time adult passport book: $130 application fee + $35 execution fee = $165 total. Minors under 16: $100 + $35. Add $60 for expedited processing. See our full fee breakdown for cards, renewals and delivery options.
